Seed machine-read set: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, README.md, docs/README.md, docs/agent/**, docs/internal/repo-admin-settings.md, docs/internal/dev-loop-worktrees.md, docs/operations/ci-local-parity.md, docs/reference/public-contracts.md, docs/publish-allowlist.txt, docs/publish-exclusions.txt, docs/linkcheck_ignore.txt, tests/uat/CHARTER.md, .claude/**, **/SKILL.md, prompts/**, *.md under benchbox/, scripts/, _project/scripts/, .github/. Drift guard resolves string literals, '/'-joined Path chains, os.path.join and __file__-relative constants in benchbox/, scripts/, _project/scripts/, tests/, .github/workflows/, Makefile, make/*.mk; indexes basenames; fails on tracked symlinks into inert paths. Selection maps each machine-read doc to the tests that read it. path-filters.yml routes machine-read docs as code.
